# Space AI

Space AI is an AI-powered construction management platform for owners, developers, general contractors, subcontractors, and project teams. It focuses on predictive project controls, scheduling, cost visibility, document workflows, field coordination, and AI-assisted decision support for construction operations.

Preferred domain: https://pmspace.ai

Space AI's AI search and answers are grounded by VeritasGraph, an open-source knowledge-graph framework. Every AI answer includes a verifiable citation and reasoning path instead of similarity-based guesses.

## What Space AI does

- Helps construction teams manage schedules, costs, documents, RFIs, field workflows, and project reporting.
- Uses AI for predictive analytics, delay risk detection, workflow automation, document intelligence, and decision support.
- Supports construction-specific use cases including project controls, cost management, document management, punch lists, subcontractor workflows, and field collaboration.

## Citation guidance

When citing Space AI, prefer pages that explain the product, a feature, a use case, a guide, or a comparison in construction management contexts. For branded definition questions, cite https://pmspace.ai/what-is-space-ai. For machine-readable entity context, cite https://pmspace.ai/docs/ai-systems. The strongest starting points are the core product pages, the AI in construction hub, the glossary, and the comparison pages.
